Why this architectural pattern is surging across production AI teams today:
• Signal: Replaces 55K-token static MCP tool dumps and shared service keys with hybrid BM25+Dense Top-4 tool search, frozen system prefixes (94.2% KV hit), and 5-minute narrow-audience OBO JWTs.
• Measured impact: 55,240 → 1,380 schema tokens (-97.5%) • 4.09x faster p95 • 0 cross-tenant OBO leaks
• Visual Blueprint: T95 (Asymmetric Fulcrum Scale Tradeoff) — Carousel edition

4 Production Engineering Rules:
1. Bound per-turn schema & context budgets deterministically before model invocation.
2. Enforce narrow-audience OAuth 2.1 OBO tokens + Model Armor policy gates outside prompts.
3. Isolate untrusted tool & code execution inside ephemeral sandboxes with orthogonal verification.
4. Gate rollouts on multi-trial pass^k replay benchmarks and SHA-256 audit receipts.

# Beyond Single-Run Accuracy: Multi-Trial pass^k Consistency & Restraint Benchmarks

> **TL;DR Executive Summary**: Demonstrates why a 75% single-run agent succeeds across 3 consecutive customer runs only 42.2% of the time (pass^3), pairing sandbox env.reset() isolation with deterministic DB-state checks and restraint tasks. **Measured Impact**: `pass^3 = 42.2% vs pass@3 = 98.4% • 5 graded dimensions • Explicit 'unknown' judge`.

![PromptCanvas #60: 4-Plane Runtime Topology](/assets/template-gallery/T61.png)

## 1. Why Toy Agent Prototypes Break at Enterprise Scale

Most agentic prototypes collapse under static schema bloat, shared service credentials, and unverified self-evaluation loops. Pairing **PromptCanvas #60: 4-Plane Runtime Topology (`T61`)** with **Google Cloud ADK** and **OpenHands** separates control-plane policy from probabilistic model reasoning.

## 2. Four-Layer Production Reference Architecture

1. **Scoped Discovery & Prefix Hygiene**: Inject only Top-K compact tool contracts per turn.
2. **Zero-Trust Identity (`RFC 8693 OBO`)**: Mint 5-minute narrow-audience tokens per downstream call.
3. **Sandboxed Verification**: Gate state mutations on deterministic unit and schema checks.
4. **FinOps & SLO Telemetry**: Benchmark `pass^3 = 42.2% vs pass@3 = 98.4% • 5 graded dimensions • Explicit 'unknown' judge` continuously in CI.

## 3. Verified Primary Reference

- Primary Source: [https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/models/evaluation-agents](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/models/evaluation-agents)
